column1: # AQL Language Specification: Boolean & Logic (and or not all any
# eq neq gt lt gte lte implies otherwise guard xor xnor nand nor iff)
# Comparison words gt/lt/gte/lte are non-commutative like the math words:
# the handler computes `args[1] OP args[0]`, so the SWAP form `a gt b`
# short-circuit and use the swap form (BarrierPos 1): the left operand is
# taken from the stack, the right from the forward token.

column3: and returns the falsy operand (value semantics)
and of two truthy values returns an operand

column1: # §2  or / otherwise — short-circuit, swap form `a or b`

column3: or returns the first truthy operand
empty string is falsy → right operand
otherwise: left wins when not None

column1: # §3  guard — `cond guard value` → value if cond else None

column3: condition true passes the value through
or needs two operands (swap form: a or b)
